description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.resourceManager class, which manages resources such as plugins and themes for CKEditor. It includes methods for registering, retrieving, and loading resources, as well as handling external resource paths.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.resourceManager
classes.description: A class for managing resources like plugins and themes within CKEditor, providing methods to add, retrieve, and load resources, as well as manage external resource paths.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Registers a resource with a given name and definition, and fires an event indicating the resource is ready.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a registered resource by name.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the URL path for a specific loaded resource.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the full file URL for a specific loaded resource.

methods.name: addExternal
methods.description: Registers external resources to be loaded from a specified external path.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads one or more resources by name, executing a callback upon completion.
